body:
Il docente può ora annotare e registrare un passaggio nella Room, condividerlo in Aula e ritrovarne l'esito nelle consegne e nel diario. Lo studente formula una previsione su Poiseuille prima del risultato, distingue pressione e portata fissate, recupera la fonte esatta e affronta un problema diverso. Sessione CAS, journal/media/bundle canonici e servizi Study Core esistenti conservano identità e provenienza.

Stacked su #297, head verificata `ae25b93bec826539940e0226da1f0cd8cebff0b1`, ancora draft. **HEAD finale `f456ade218acee1a8b65f5dc24e9220681658b11`**. Ramo isolato escluso dall'autodeploy Vercel; nessun merge o deploy.

## Percorso e contratti

- Studio → **Registra e collega un passaggio** → annotazione reale → consenso esplicito → cattura/stop → **Copia passaggio per il corso**.
- Aula → **Apri episodio guidato** → docente condivide riferimento e trascrizione → studente prevede, riceve recupero sul vincolo e torna al replay → nuova prova → docente vede ricevuta/revisione/diario.
- Più take indipendenti e pause; ultimo segmento nativo drenato e verificato prima del marker. Nessuna cattura dal consenso salvato.
- Export A esclude B; nuovo store importa e riproduce. Revoca corrente e delle aperture precedenti; fence contro import/rollback concorrente e revisione esterna falsificata. Copie esterne già esportate fuori dal controllo dell'app.
- Evento journal v2 strettamente validato; contenitore bundle1 con minimumReader2 solo per AUDIO-V2. Fonte con sessione/digest/oggetto/versione; nessuna comprensione semantica dedotta dal tempo.
- Due varianti editoriali, solver Core e domini esistenti; ricevuta conserva assistenza e risultati precedenti, senza nuovo ledger. Font locali, fit replay e testo completo a390px.

Spec originale con Node26.5.1 del lock:4PASS. La controprova deterministica perde popstate tra titolo visibile e listener passivo; findByRole non recupera un evento già perso, un secondo evento dopo la sottoscrizione sì. Layout effect per il listener; RED→5PASS e controfattuale conservati, getByRole e rifiuto del riferimento obsoleto intatti. Il singolo fallimento storico40083426275 non è stato riprodotto identicamente e non viene cancellato da un rerun.

Una separata controprova Web distingue readiness del modulo Work dal flusso401. Una riga di setup attende l'import reale, senza cambiare timeout, mock o asserzioni privacy; nessuna correzione auth rivendicata.

- Chromium nativo/UI Studio20/20 e docente/studente20/20; desktop390/1440, tastiera/movimento ridotto, nuovo store, import/revoca e audio decodificabile. Manifest runtime confrontati; screenshot e trace sanificate.
- Review indipendente14PASS dopo RED conservati: isolamento, tail, errori start/CAS, revoca/import, pin e round-trip; corretto anche budget fonti notebook.

[Consegna e riproduzione](https://github.com/AndreaMarro/ardesia/blob/f456ade218acee1a8b65f5dc24e9220681658b11/docs/deliveries/2026-10-24-audio-v2/README.md) · [Validazione, risultati negativi e manifest](https://github.com/AndreaMarro/ardesia/blob/f456ade218acee1a8b65f5dc24e9220681658b11/docs/deliveries/2026-10-24-audio-v2/validation.md) · [Review indipendente](https://github.com/AndreaMarro/ardesia/blob/f456ade218acee1a8b65f5dc24e9220681658b11/docs/deliveries/2026-10-24-audio-v2/evidence/review/independent-review.md).

Questa draft ripara quei confini senza aggiungere dipendenze, cambiare schema v2 o indebolire i gate. Include la consegna richiesta dal mandato del 24 ottobre, con canoni aggiornati, revisione indipendente, contratti e prove riproducibili.

## Modifiche applicative

- AudioRecorder: take/generazioni, permessi tardivi rilasciati, consenso serializzato, attesa del tail nativo e delle scritture/marker; errori osservabili e purge completato anche dopo una registrazione fallita.
- Replay: fonte esplicita per room, verifica dell'identità, nessun fallback flat silenzioso, stato e URL audio posseduti dal caricamento corretto.
- JournalRecorder: normalizzazione mirata degli optional undefined di Excalidraw. Il validator conserva il rifiuto di valori e descrittori non JSON.
- Range replay: precisione di 1 ms, così End raggiunge l'ultimo evento anche quando la durata non è multipla di 100.

Addresses #292 and #294. Le issue e gli audit precedenti sono riconosciuti; la review distingue i fix da questa sessione e il lavoro già disponibile.

La prima consegna applicativa verificata è il commit `49bf90ce782457494fed52c8e1a812bf27ba158b`, tree `f7906efbcc0104cdcc1be7818d3961c040de4d5c`, identico al tree locale collaudato. L'aggiornamento documentale successivo è descritto in fondo; non cambia sorgenti, dipendenze o test applicativi.

I run locali identificano base più diff e hash dei sorgenti. **Verifica remota conclusa il 24 ottobre 2026 sul nuovo SHA `49bf90ce782457494fed52c8e1a812bf27ba158b`:**

- [CI generale — success](https://github.com/AndreaMarro/ardesia/actions/runs/40080464182): tutti e sette i job conclusi con success, inclusi Studio, Web, Engine, Study API, Study MCP, hygiene e golden path advisory.

La banca è collegata alle edizioni di Fisica mediante `questionBankIds`, conservando i JSON e gli SHA dei CoursePack esistenti.

title: D2-J1: real Studio .lesson reaches the engine (+ hardening)
body:
# D2-J1: real Studio `.lesson` reaches the engine (manifest + v2 journal) + hardening

> **Review scope (read this first).** This branch contains the whole local
> `fix/246` stack in its ancestry (unrelated work, pending separately).
> The reviewable unit of THIS PR is exactly **two commits on top of
> `fba5d035`** — nothing else:
>
> - `f45b01cf` — `fix(ingest): accept canonical Studio lesson bundles` (D2-J1)
> - `5a040b6b` — `fix(ingest): harden canonical lesson bundle contract` (D2-J1.1)
>
> Suggested review range: `git log fba5d035..5a040b6b` (2 commits, 2 files:
> `packages/engine/lessonos/ingest/bundle.py`,
> `packages/engine/tests/test_ingest_bundle.py`).
> No Studio changes. No CLI changes. No schema changes. No new dependencies.

## Objective

Make this sentence true, falsifiable and permanently protected:

> **A `.lesson` really produced by Studio enters the current LessonOS
> engine and yields segments + a capsule bound to the same lesson,
> without being rebuilt by hand or converted to a different format.**

## Architecture decision (frozen)

- **No `LessonDocument`** (or DocumentIR/ArtifactDocument/UniversalDocument):
  before introducing a new documental representation, make the already
  existing `Studio .lesson → Engine` junction actually traversable. The
  engine already owns downstream documental pipelines; D2-J1 does not
  duplicate them.
- `LessonOutcome` (Studio recap boundary, D1) stays the Studio surface;
  this unit connects Studio to the existing engine instead.
- No new CLI (`bin/ingest-bundle.sh` + `read_bundle()`/`ingest_bundle()`
  already exist; canonical ingest CLI is a possible later D2-J2, not here).

## What was broken (reproduced, not assumed)

On a byte-real bundle produced by production `exportLesson()` +
production `JournalRecorder` (`lessonId=test-d2-junction`, synthetic
content, `audioConsent=false`):

1. `read_bundle()` rejected it: `unsafe bundle member 'manifest.json'`
   (old `_is_safe_member` allowed only `raw/*`).
2. After allowing the manifest, `journal_to_segments()` returned **0
   segments**: the Studio journal holds EventEnvelope v2
   (`journal.element.add/update/delete`, no `type`/`t` fields) which the
   old T8 parser silently ignored.

## Implementation (f45b01cf)

- `manifest.json` at ZIP root: allowed **exactly** (allowlist NOT widened
  to `*`); ZipSlip guard intact for everything else.
- Manifest v1 parsed + cross-checked: object root, bundleVersion==1,
  schemaVersion==1, valid lessonId (Studio room pattern mirror), required
  files present, `files[]` bytes+SHA-256 verified (hashlib stdlib).
  Coherence, NOT signature. Legacy manifest-less path preserved
  (`manifest=None`).
- Identity binding: `manifest.lessonId == requested lesson_id` else
  `ValueError`; every segment-contributing v2 event must carry the same
  `lessonId` (no renaming B as A).
- v2 adapter at the ingest boundary: `journal.element.add/update/delete`
  normalized to the legacy shape, so update/delete/ordering semantics run
  ONCE. `occurredAt` ISO → epoch ms deterministically; input order kept
  for ties. Legacy `{t, type}` path byte-identical in behavior.
- Corrupt-but-recognisable v2 rows raise `ValueError` (never skipped as
  "unknown legacy"); other v2 kinds (pointer/math/pdf/lesson.*) ignored.

## Hardening (5a040b6b, from independent GLM-5.3 review)

- **F1** manifest inventory is now a bijection:
  `set(zip files − manifest.json) == set(files[].path)` (dirs excluded).
- **F2** duplicate file members rejected fail-closed (zipfile is
  last-wins; Studio rejects them too).
- **F3** v2-hint detection mirroring Studio `looksLikeJournalEnvelopeV2`
  (any 1 of 12 canonical keys): v2-like rows are always strictly
  validated, never fall back to legacy. Legacy `{t,type}` has zero top-
  level key overlap → no false positives (locked by test).
- **F4** single temporal semantics: baseline `t0` = min over ALL valid
  journal events (legacy `t` + same-lesson v2 `occurredAt`), not only
  segment-producing ones; per-element `start=min`/`end=max` of its current
  life; text = temporally latest event (tmax); delete→re-add still a new
  life.
- **F5** strict manifest versions (`type() is int`: `true`/`1.0` rejected).
- **F8/F9/F10** (opportunistic, few lines each): non-object JSONL rows →
  explicit `ValueError` (was opaque `AttributeError`); v2 element without
  `id` → explicit reject; ZipSlip docstring made precise.

## SESSION KNOWLEDGE

### New facts discovered
- Studio journal rows on disk are v2 envelopes (`JSON.stringify(envelope)`
  in `JournalRecorder.appendBatch`); legacy `{t,type}` lines only exist in
  old bundles/tests — the engine T8 parser was therefore blind to every
  modern export.
- Studio manifest already carries per-file bytes+sha256 + ordered
  sessionIds + lessonOs status; the engine now verifies the subset it
  uses (versions, lessonId, required files, inventory bytes/hash).
- `ingest_bundle()` already took `lesson_id` but used it only as a seg_id
  prefix — it now also anchors identity checks.
- jsdom lacks `navigator.locks`, so `JournalRecorder` needs the
  constructor-injected `withExclusiveLock` in tests (supported seam).

### Bugs reproduced
- manifest.json rejected as unsafe (PRIMARY RED, real bundle).
- 0 segments from v2 journal (SECONDARY, real bundle).
- F1 unlisted-payload accepted; F2 duplicates accepted last-wins;
  F3 v2-like-without-schemaVersion silently ignored;
  F4 v2-pointer excluded from t0 + first-seen (not min) start +
  file-order (not temporal) text.

### Assumptions falsified
- HYPOTHESIS: `readEnvelopesByLesson`-style full-scan is the only debt →
  OBSERVED: correctness gaps (F1–F4) mattered more; performance debt
  stands, untouched. CONCLUSION: correctness first, as specified.
- HYPOTHESIS: legacy `{t,type}` rows might carry v2 hint keys →
  OBSERVED: zero top-level overlap (`t/type/element/elementId` vs 12
  canonical keys). CONCLUSION: ≥1-hint detection is safe.
- HYPOTHESIS: non-element v2 rows need full validation →
  OBSERVED: timestamp+identity suffice for t0; payload shape only for
  segment contributors. CONCLUSION: minimal strictness, documented.

### Existing capabilities discovered (reused, not duplicated)
- `bin/ingest-bundle.sh` already wires read→segments→capsule→graph→summary
  (no new CLI needed to verify the junction).
- Studio `embeddedIdentity` + manifest sessionIds coherence checks already
  guard the export side; engine checks mirror them on ingest.
- `MockProvider`+`Router` make the capsule step deterministic offline.

### Useful commands/probes
- `cd packages/engine && uv run pytest tests/test_ingest_bundle.py`
- `env -u KIMI_API_KEY uv run pytest -q` (deterministic suite via the
  repo's own `skipif` on absent `KIMI_API_KEY`)
- Authentic probe pattern: Studio vitest (jsdom) with real
  `JournalRecorder.recordChange()` + `flush()` + real `exportLesson()`,
  bytes to `/tmp`, then engine `read_bundle → journal_to_segments →
  ingest_bundle` with `MockProvider` (probe file deleted afterwards).

### Compatibility constraints
- Legacy manifest-less bundles: unchanged behavior (`manifest=None`).
- Legacy `{t,type}` journal lines incl. malformed-line skip: unchanged.
- Malformed v2 is strict while malformed legacy stays lenient — deliberate
  asymmetry (canonical format must fail closed; historical leniency kept).

### Security/privacy observations
- ZipSlip stays fail-closed (validate-then-act, now incl. duplicates).
- Revoked-audio GDPR rule untouched and still tested.
- Manifest checks are integrity/coherence, never authentication.
- All fixtures synthetic; no student data, no audio, no secrets touched.

### Performance observations
- `readEnvelopesByLesson` full-scan+filter (Studio side) stands as known
  debt; engine `read_bundle` reads listed payloads once for hashing —
  no new hot path.

### Deferred issues
- Capsule → ContentAtom/lineage/Markdown/Quarto/PDF downstream unverified.
- Canonical ingest CLI ergonomics (D2-J2 candidate).
- `readEnvelopesByLesson` lesson-only index (Studio perf debt).
- 3 live-Kimi tests fail on provider HTTP 404 (external, pre-existing).

### Next real boundary
Capsule (from a real ingest) → ContentAtom / GeneratedArtifact lineage:
first downstream link not yet demonstrated. NOT started here.

## VERIFICATION

- Targeted: `uv run pytest tests/test_ingest_bundle.py` →
  48 passed (D2-J1) → 67 passed (D2-J1.1), 0 failed.
- Deterministic suite: `env -u KIMI_API_KEY uv run pytest -q` →
  2079 passed, 7 skipped, 0 failed (official skipif mechanism).
- Full suite as-is: 2 failed, both live-Kimi provider HTTP 404 with key
  present (`test_llm_kimi::test_live_completion`,
  `test_realtime_eval.py::TestRealtimeEvalLiveKimi`); neither imports
  `lessonos.ingest.bundle` → unrelated, pre-existing environmental.
- Real-bundle probes (2 fresh bundles, deleted afterwards):
  SHA `765d1f79…` → READ PASS, 2 segments, capsule `test-d2-junction`;
  SHA `24485e48…` → READ PASS, 3 segments, capsule `test-d2-junction`;
  SHA `e95bade8…` (pointer-first + update) → READ PASS, 2 segments with
  baseline-anchored starts, capsule `test-d2-j1-hardening`.
- Mutations (all RED then restored, grep MUTANTE empty):
  manifest re-banned → T1 RED; identity check off → T5 RED;
  `journal.element.add` ignored → T7 RED; inventory off → F1 RED;
  duplicates allowed → F2 RED; hint detection off → 10 RED;
  element-only baseline → F4-pointer RED.

## HANDOFF

- CURRENT_SHA=`5a040b6b`, BASE_SHA=`fba5d035`, BRANCH=`fix/d2-j1-1-canonical-bundle-hardening`.
- DONE: real `.lesson → segments → capsule` junction + hardening F1–F5/F8–F10.
- PROVEN: byte-real Studio bundles (3 probes), identity binding both
  levels, legacy compat, fail-closed parsing, mutation-tested suite.
- NOT PROVEN: anything downstream of the capsule.
- NEXT: Capsule → ContentAtom lineage (separate task).
- DO NOT TOUCH: Studio code, cli.py, exporters, DB schema, gates, the
  unrelated `fix/246` stack in ancestry, other agents' unmerged paths.
